video_title: REACTION: First Celtics-76ers Matchup & NBA Teams In The Danger Zone

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics blow out 76ers in hyped matchup
quotes.excerpt: Boston completely blows out Philly down the stretch to get a nice win on the road
quotes.quote: It was a two or three-point game going to the fourth quarter and then Boston completely blows out Philly down the stretch to get a nice win on the road to improve to 9 and 2. And all important, let's track who's in first place on November 10th. Let it be known that first place in the East belongs to the Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul George's impressive return to Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: This was supposed to be the Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum first matchup and people seem to forget
quotes.quote: This was supposed to be the Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum first matchup and people seem to forget. It was also Paul George's return to Philly game. He didn't forget. He put up 36. And quite frankly, for a guy who was shooting in the low to mid 40s on threes this year, I don't think Philly had the requisite game plan.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: The 76ers remain not a great offensive team. Joel Embiid was two of nine in this game
quotes.quote: The 76ers remain not a great offensive team. Joel Embiid was two of nine in this game and I think over the last four games, he's something in the neighborhood of nine of 36. I think it's a perfect 25%. He did get to the foul line in this game, but he had his first three-pointer I think in three weeks.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics bench is a powerful weapon
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics bench is a powerful weapon for them. They did it again
quotes.quote: The Celtics bench is a powerful weapon for them. They did it again. Peyton Pritchard with 18 points in 30 minutes, hit four threes. Sam Hauser hit four threes. Hugo Gonzalez hit a couple of threes. Gonzalez plus 17, Peyton Pritchard plus 26. I guess when Jaylen was off, Pritchard was on, because plus 26 in 30 minutes. Talk about impactful basketball.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavs' roster situation and pressure on Kenny Atkinson
quotes.excerpt: The Cavs' overall situation has deteriorated over the last couple of years

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Cavs' overall situation has deteriorated over the last couple of years. Two years ago when they were a 60-win team, they had a $165 million payroll. Part of that was because Evan Mobley was still on his rookie contract. Their payroll is now $210 million. They have no tradeable first-round picks and one tradeable second-round pick. They are $45,000 below the hard cap of the first apron. The pressure is being applied to Kenny Atkinson.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: They have the third-worst five-man lineup out there at a minus 19 per 100 when the group of Harden, Mitchell, Watson, Mobley, and Allen is on the court.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill's role and Cavs' depth issues
quotes.excerpt: Sam Merrill has gone from their tenth or eleventh man to their sixth man
quotes.quote: Sam Merrill has gone from their tenth or eleventh man to their sixth man, because they have hollowed out their depth and had to spend on signing a lot of their players. You may argue that actually Mario Hezonja is their sixth man, or that Jaylen Tyson is their sixth man, but essentially Sam Merrill has gone from their tenth or eleventh man to their sixth man.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavs cannot trade Jarrett Allen without a center back
quotes.excerpt: You can't trade Jarrett Allen unless you are getting a center back
quotes.quote: You can't trade Jarrett Allen unless you are getting a center back. So the reason you can't is because Evan Mobley has not proven he can be their starting center. He has not proven it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Doc Rivers and Giannis Antetokounmpo's relationship
quotes.excerpt: I don't know what to make about this Doc Rivers, Giannis Antetokounmpo back and forth this week
quotes.quote: I don't know what to make about this Doc Rivers, Giannis Antetokounmpo back and forth this week. When we last left you, Doc said some things on Bill Simmons' podcast that targeted Giannis's IQ and coachability. Giannis came back by saying he ain't my coach and I have to focus on positivity in my life.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Doc Rivers' apology for IQ comments
quotes.excerpt: Doc apologized specifically for using the term IQ when he said he meant to say feel
quotes.quote: Doc apologized specifically for using the term IQ when he said he meant to say feel for the game. Whatever, the Giannis Doc tenure was a disaster. Doc did a god-awful job in Milwaukee. They were 30 and 13 when Adrian Griffin got fired and he was sub 500.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: They picked up some stuff for Giannis Antetokounmpo. They have picks, but the picks aren't till far out
quotes.quote: They picked up some stuff for Giannis Antetokounmpo. They have picks, but the picks aren't till far out. They can't trade any of their own picks.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard's contract and trade value
quotes.excerpt: Dames on their books for what is it Bobby like 22 million for four more years
quotes.quote: Dames on their books for what is it Bobby like 22 million for four more years. So they are paying Dame more than the Trail Blazers are paying Dame to actually play for them and play well. It's not even close. They're paying him 50% more.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks' dead money and trade restrictions
quotes.excerpt: They're paying between Dame and Kevin Porter who they also waived, they're paying 26 million dollars
quotes.quote: They're paying between Dame and Kevin Porter who they also waived, they're paying 26 million dollars. Actually, Vasilije Micic is on their dead money too. They've got $27 million in dead money. They don't control any of their own picks going forward because the picks are either traded or swapped.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: Andrew Wiggins was pulled from the starting lineup. He played really, really poorly
quotes.quote: Andrew Wiggins was pulled from the starting lineup. He played really, really poorly when they lost to the Warriors last week and he did not start in Sacramento. Now he played 32 minutes off the bench, but that I thought was very interesting.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: They're starting Danny Wolf at two guard. I thought he was a four five
quotes.quote: They're starting Danny Wolf at two guard. I thought he was a four five. Am I wrong? I thought he was a four five.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis's performance and injury status
quotes.excerpt: AD had 44 points and he just missed a couple games with an ankle injury
quotes.quote: AD had 44 points and he just missed a couple games with an ankle injury, which is that's what happens with AD, but he he had 44 and 13 in the Wizards loss on Monday.
